title: Provider-neutral storage with immutable media identities
statement: Storage behavior is expressed through capability-aware provider-neutral ports, while originals and deterministic derivatives use application-generated immutable identities.
rationale: Local, Azure Blob, and S3-compatible systems differ in conditional operations and checksums, so adapters expose capabilities without weakening immutability.

anchors.locator: Unsupported operations return `Unsupported`; adapters must not silently replace a conditional write with a race-prone `HEAD`/`PUT`.

evidence.locator: | Storage | Local, Azure Blob, generic S3 adapter with AWS/R2/B2/MinIO profiles |
